pages.text: Shows a multiblock $(l)in the world$(): what to place and where, before you place a single block. Lock the projection in place to build it by hand, or let Builder drones build it for you.
$(l)Right-click$() to open the list of structures and see the blocks each one takes:
pages.title: Picking a structure

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Multiblocks$(): the $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l) and the $(l:nuclear/steam_turbine)Steam Turbine$(/l) in all three sizes, the $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l) chamber, tiers 2 to 4 of the $(l:energy_storage/resonance_core)Resonance Core$(/l) (tier 1 is the core alone), the $(l:mech/mech_hangar)Mech Hangar$(/l) and the $(l:mech/mech_core)Crystallizer$(/l) chamber.

$(li)$(l)Schematics$(), marked in emerald, below the multiblocks: buildings saved with a $(l)Structure Block$(). Schematics up to 40 blocks a side are shown.$(br)$(li)The $(l:drone_systems/tech_village)tech village$(/l)'s buildings, once you $(l)learn$() their $(l)Blueprint Disc$().
Small machines that assemble from Cyber Frames are not in the list: click one and its own drones show you where the frames go.

$(li)While you hold it, the projection $(l)follows the block you look at$(). The structure $(l)stands on$() the face you aim at, the controller on the side towards you, facing you, and the rest stretches away from you.
pages.title: Placing the projection

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Sneak + right-click a block$() to lock it there. $(l)Mini drones$() fly out to hold the projection, each over a group of blocks.$(br)$(li)Lock it on a controller you already placed and the projection lines up with it.

$(li)Pick a village upgrade near its village and the projection locks itself over the building it upgrades, so it shows only what the upgrade adds.$(br)$(li)$(l)Sneak + right-click the air$() to unlock it, and the drones fly home.

$(li)$(l)Soft glow (following your gaze)$(): a block still to place$(br)$(li)$(l)**Red$() block (following your gaze)**: a wrong block, or one in a space that must stay empty$(br)$(li)$(l)Blocks in a cone of light (locked)$(): blocks still to place
pages.title: Reading the projection

pages.text: $(li)$(l)**Amber X$() (locked)**: something in the way$(br)$(li)$(l)Nothing drawn$(): the block is already correct$(br)Above the hotbar the projector counts what is left, and says when the structure is complete. When any CyberFarm multiblock forms, a ring of light rises through it from the bottom to the top.
$(l)Right-click a$() $(l:drone_systems/swarm_dock)Builder Swarm Dock$(/l) with a locked projection, and its Mini Drones with a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Builder Module$(/l) build it for you.
pages.title: Building it with drones

pages.text: In creative, right-clicking a block $(l)clears the site and builds$() the structure right away (where it is locked, or where it is projected), with plain casings. Swap in the ports you need.
pages.title: Creative mode

pages.text: Any data pack can add schematics: put the Structure Block file in data/<namespace>/structure/schematic/. Its north side is its front, which turns towards you.
pages.title: Adding schematics
